title: acer campestre subvar. molle
intro: Acer campestre subvar. molle, commonly known as Field Maple, is a subvariety of the Field Maple tree, native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Field Maple subvar. molle include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
